ek Harness plugin: token usage, estimated cost, budget and live CPU monitoring across real sessions.
# dsh-usage-insights

A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that adds a
**用量统计 / Usage Stats** entry to the left sidebar and op

ens a full statistics panel built from
the profile's real, durable session logs.
There is no synthetic data and no separate ledger: totals, per-session figures, and the timeline are
all folded from committed `assistant/message` usage records.
## What it shows
| Area | Content |

| KPI row | Total tokens, session count with sub-agent split, estimated cost, budget remaining |
| B
udget | Spent vs. budget, progress bar, today, 7-day daily average, 30-day projection, days remainin

g |
| Timeline | Daily bars over 7 / 14 / 30 days on a labelled value axis; stacked cache-read / inp
ut / output tokens, output-only tokens, or cost; hovering a day shows its exact breakdown, and today

is marked on the axis |
| Sessions | Sortable, searchable table of every session, 10 per page with
page controls and a pinned header: model, token total, estimated cost, last activity; expanding a ro

w reveals the token breakdown, models, working directory, session ID, and parent session |
| CPU | P
rocess CPU (per-core and machine share), system CPU, load 1/5/15, memory, uptime, per-core bars, and

a rolling sparkline of recent samples |
| Rates | Collapsible table of the estimated USD-per-1M-tok
en rates used for the cost figure |
The sidebar icon is registered at order 5, between **Plugins** and **Schedules**.
## Requirements
- A Harness profile composed with the Web GUI (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` or equivalent), providing

`ctx.sessionQuery` and `ctx.webServer`.
- A Node/Host runtime with `node:os` (all standard DSH deskt
op/web deployments).
Developed and verified against DSH `0.2.1-rc.5`.
## Install
Clone the repository, then install the cloned directory as a bundle into a profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
In the Harness Web UI, use **Plugins → Add** and select the cloned `dsh-usage-insights` folder; the
profile's bundle selection and `dsh.profile.bundles` are updated for you. Programmatic callers can u

se
the `plugin_manager` action `install_bundle` with the cloned directory as the absolute `target`.
The plugin ships no runtime dependencies, so there is no `npm install` step: install the folder as-i
e plugin ships no runtime dependencies, so there is no `npm install` step: install the folder as-is.
The bundle inserts this row through its `cordis.patch.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Once active, open **用量统计** in the left sidebar. No page reload is needed on a profile with HMR;
othe
rwise restart the profile after installation.
## Data source

- `ctx.sessionQuery.listSessions()` enumerates the whole logical corpus (all workspaces, live and
pe

rsisted sessions, including sub-agents).
- `ctx.sessionQuery.readSession(id)` replays each log; the

Host folds only committed
`assistant/message` events carrying provider `usage`. Events copied into a

fork
(`inheritedEventCount`) are skipped so parent usage is not counted twice.
- Session titles com

e from the latest `session/title` event, falling back to the first user message.
- CPU/memory come f
rom `node:os` and `process` inside the Host process, sampled every 2 seconds.

The Host caches per-session folds: live sessions refresh at most every 10 s and the whole corpus
eve
ry 5 min, so a 5-second browser poll never replays every log.
## Cost model
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Rates are **USD per 1,000,000 tokens**. Reasoning tokens are a subset of output and are not charged

twice. These are estimates at configured rates, not billing records. Defaults are DeepSeek-style
est
imates and should be adjusted to the rates on your account.
## Configuration

Edit the `usage-insights` row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, or the `config` block in this
bun
dle's `cordis.patch.yml` before installing:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Field | Default | Meaning |
| `budgetUsd` | `20` | Budget ceiling for spent/remaining figures; `0` disables the ceiling display

|
| `timelineDays` | `30` | Days of daily buckets the Host returns (7–90) |
| `refreshMs` | `5000` |

Browser poll interval (minimum 2000) |
| `liveRefreshMs` | `10000` | Minimum re-read interval for a

live session |
| `fullRefreshMs` | `300000` | Full corpus re-read interval |
| `includeSubagents` |

`true` | Count sub-agent sessions in totals and the table |
| `pricing` | DeepSeek estimates | Per-

model rates in USD per 1M tokens |
| `defaultPrice` | same as above | Fallback rate for models not l

ates in USD per 1M tokens |
| `defaultPrice` | same as above | Fallback rate for models not listed |

Budget figures compare the **all-time estimated cost** against `budgetUsd`; the 30-day projection
us
es the last seven days' average daily cost.
## Transport and privacy

The Host registers one read-only exact route, `GET /usage-insights/snapshot`, on the existing
`webSe

rver`. It returns aggregates, session titles, working directories, session IDs, and
CPU/memory count

ers — never message content. The route is unauthenticated like every other named
route on that carri
er, so it inherits the server's loopback bind. Responses are `no-store`.
## Repository layout
| File | Role |

| `index.js` | Host half: corpus fold, cost/budget, CPU sampler, snapshot route |
| `client.js` | Cl

ient half: sidebar panel icon + main panel React view (plain JS, no JSX) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bu

ndle patch that inserts the `usage-insights` row |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | Plugin Man

ager display metadata |
| `icon.svg` | Original icon (bars) |
| `package.json` | Bundle manifest: `d
sh.bundle.patch`, `dsh.client`, exports |
## Development notes

- The Host half is plain ESM: `export function apply(ctx, config)` plus `inject`.
- The Client half

is a plain-JavaScript `window.__ModuleLoader__` factory: no build step, no JSX, and
only `react` fro

m the shared module table.
- The plugin owns no dependencies; installing it links this directory int

o the profile.
- `client.js` talks to `index.js` through the Host route described above rather than

a generated
Remote namespace, so the bundle stays dependency-free.
